rules.sourceTitle: Yard — Home Loan product page, "Borrower type" table
rules.note: The product table lists borrower types as "Salaried employees / Self-employed / Non-residents". Citizen and permanent-resident acceptance is implicit but not separately stated, so no rule has been recorded for them. The Columbus-issued Prime TMD that Yard distributes requires an Australian citizen or permanent resident, which conflicts with the non-resident borrower type on Yard's own page — confirm with the lender before relying on it.

gaps: Most figures come from Yard's undated public product pages, so asAt is the date read (2026-07-29) rather than a stated policy effective date. Yard's own Prime TMDs are dated 13 February 2024 and contain no LVR or loan-amount figures at all.
No servicing parameters published at all.
No income-type table or shading percentages for overtime, bonus, commission, rental or Centrelink income.
No PAYG employment tenure minimums published (only the self-employed ABN rules).
No credit-history policy published (defaults, bankruptcy, arrears, enquiries).
No minimum unit size, high-density or postcode policy published.
No genuine savings, gifted deposit or guarantor policy published.

Residency: Yard's product page lists non-residents as an accepted borrower type while the Columbus Prime TMD it distributes requires Australian citizenship or permanent residency — the two are not reconciled publicly.

Broker distribution confirmed from the Prime TMD distribution table ("Third party – Mortgage Managers and Accredited mortgage brokers subject to their Best Interests Duty"); Yard publishes no broker accreditation page and also operates its own brokerage (Yard Broker Pty Ltd, CR 541605).
Yard's website terms restrict automated data collection; all facts here were read from ordinary public page loads and published PDFs.
